newsitem.title: SWEDEN: FORECAST-Swedish Aug c/a surplus seen 3.0 bln skr.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST-Swedish Aug c/a surplus seen 3.0 bln skr.

text.p: Sweden's current account for August is expected to show a surplus of three billion crowns, a Reuter poll of 13 analysts found on Friday.
The range of the estimates was from a deficit of 0.5 billion crowns to a surplus of 4.6 billion.
Sweden had a current account surplus of 2.8 billion crowns in July, after a 5.2 billion crown surplus in June.
The Riksbank is due to publish the August current account figure at 1000 GMT on October 18.
